claim: A Route 53 health checker uncompresses a response before searching for the string only if the web server used a compression algorithm that health checkers support. If the response is compressed using another algorithm, the health checker can't decompress the response before searching, so the search will almost always fail and Route 53 will consider the endpoint unhealthy.

evidence.quote: If the response is compressed using another algorithm, the health checker can't decompress the response before searching for the string. In this case, the search will almost always fail, and Route 53 will consider the endpoint unhealthy

If the endpoint is a web server that returns a response that is compressed, the Route 53 health checker will uncompress the response before checking for the specified search string only if the web server compressed the response using a compression algorithm that health checkers support.
